sources.title: Desktop Metal Binder Jet Design Principles
sources.titleEn: Desktop Metal Binder Jet Design Principles
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 立體光固化成形
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：補償因子定義清楚，保留件落在公差內，局部翹曲另列，不將示例收縮率當成材料常數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Define scaling unambiguously, meet tolerance on held-out parts, separate local distortion, and avoid treating example shrinkage as a material constant.
related.difference: 用明確的高度與層厚估計層數，將可見階梯、支撐痕與尺寸誤差分開驗收。
related.differenceEn: Estimate layer count from height and thickness, with separate criteria for stair steps, support scars and dimensional error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 線性收縮 s 定義為 1−Lfinal/Lgreen，補償尺寸為 Ltarget/(1−s)，不是 Ltarget(1+s)。 教學目標孔距 25.00 mm，x 向收縮 16%，z 向 18%，先忽略非均勻變形。 x 生胚孔距=25/0.84=29.7619 mm；z=25/0.82=30.4878 mm。這是各向比例模型，不能預測局部翹曲。
固定層厚的層數 N=H/t；名義時間 Nτ 只估每層週期，需另列準備、清洗與後固化。 教學高度 30 mm，層厚 0.05 mm，每層合成週期 8 s；不代表任何印表機配方。 N=30/0.05=600 層；T=600×8/60=80 min。只在固定週期近似成立。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Linear shrinkage s=1−Lfinal/Lgreen gives Lgreen=Ltarget/(1−s), not Ltarget(1+s). Teaching target spacing 25.00 mm; x shrinkage 16%, z shrinkage 18%; ignore nonuniform distortion initially. Green x spacing=25/0.84=29.7619 mm; z=25/0.82=30.4878 mm. Directional scaling does not predict local warpage.

For fixed thickness N=H/t; nominal time N τ covers layer cycles only, with preparation, washing and post-curing separately listed. Teaching height 30 mm, layer thickness 0.05 mm and synthetic cycle 8 s; these are not printer settings. N=30/0.05=600 layers; T=600×8/60=80 min under a constant-cycle approximation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 金屬旋壓成形
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：補償因子定義清楚，保留件落在公差內，局部翹曲另列，不將示例收縮率當成材料常數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Define scaling unambiguously, meet tolerance on held-out parts, separate local distortion, and avoid treating example shrinkage as a material constant.
related.difference: 正確定義錐半角與厚度法向，不將剪旋壓正弦律套用全部旋壓。
related.differenceEn: Define cone half-angle and normal thickness, without applying the shear-spinning sine law to every spinning process.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 線性收縮 s 定義為 1−Lfinal/Lgreen，補償尺寸為 Ltarget/(1−s)，不是 Ltarget(1+s)。 教學目標孔距 25.00 mm，x 向收縮 16%，z 向 18%，先忽略非均勻變形。 x 生胚孔距=25/0.84=29.7619 mm；z=25/0.82=30.4878 mm。這是各向比例模型，不能預測局部翹曲。
理想剪旋壓薄錐 t=t0 sinα，其中 α 是錐壁與旋轉軸夾角；需特定材料流動假設。 合成初厚 2.0 mm，錐半角 30°，忽略回彈與局部不均。 t=2sin30°=1.0 mm；以與底面夾角 60°代入會誤得 1.732 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Linear shrinkage s=1−Lfinal/Lgreen gives Lgreen=Ltarget/(1−s), not Ltarget(1+s). Teaching target spacing 25.00 mm; x shrinkage 16%, z shrinkage 18%; ignore nonuniform distortion initially. Green x spacing=25/0.84=29.7619 mm; z=25/0.82=30.4878 mm. Directional scaling does not predict local warpage.

For ideal shear spinning t=t 0 sin α, with α between wall and rotation axis; it requires a specific flow idealization. Synthetic initial thickness 2.0 mm, half-angle 30°; neglect springback and local nonuniformity. t=2 sin 30°=1.0 mm; substituting the complementary 60° angle incorrectly gives 1.732 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
